sloka: क्षमं तवावगच्छामि महता रणकर्मणा ।न हि ते वीर सौमुख्यं प्रहर्षं वोपधारये ।। ६.१०६.१५ ।।
transliteration: kṣamaṁ tavāvagacchāmi mahatā raṇakarmaṇā ।na hi te vīra saumukhyaṁ praharṣaṁ vopadhāraye ।। 6.106.15 ।।

translations.english: "Great Ravana! After the strenuous task in the battle, there was no exhibition of your valour, and I did not cognize any superiority in your action."
